ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Acutaas Chemicals Limited announced a significant capital expenditure plan of up to Rs. 212 crores by FY2027-28 to establish a new greenfield/brownfield manufacturing plant in Gujarat for electronic grade chemicals. This substantial investment marks a key strategic initiative to enter high-value product segments and drive future growth. Other board approvals included routine re-appointments of key directors and the extension of an employee stock option scheme to subsidiary employees, supporting governance and talent retention. While the capex signals an ambitious expansion, it inherently carries execution and market adoption risks associated with new product lines.
